invariants: Business process and declared fact grain
Counterexamples for duplicates, fan-out, and invalid history

platforms.name: Amazon Redshift
platforms.revisit: distribution, sort choices, compression, and data movement for the observed workload
platforms.integrity_boundary: primary and foreign keys are informational, so executable relationship checks remain required
platforms.exercise: choose and defend a distribution strategy for the rental-line fact
platforms.evidence_label: documented platform behavior plus illustrative transfer

platforms.name: Google BigQuery
platforms.revisit: partitioning, clustering, scan patterns, and whether selected nested or repeated fields reduce useful joins
platforms.integrity_boundary: nested storage must not collapse independent business grains or hide fan-out
platforms.exercise: compare a capability bridge with a repeated capability field and reconcile both
platforms.evidence_label: documented platform behavior plus illustrative transfer

platforms.name: Snowflake
platforms.revisit: pruning, clustering only when justified, and compute isolation
platforms.integrity_boundary: standard-table primary, foreign, and unique keys are informational; tests maintain integrity
platforms.exercise: declare relationship metadata and retain grain and relationship tests
platforms.evidence_label: documented platform behavior plus illustrative transfer

platforms.name: Databricks
platforms.revisit: bronze, silver, and gold placement, table layout, and catalog boundaries
platforms.integrity_boundary: medallion layers describe progressive refinement but do not declare fact grain
platforms.exercise: place raw exports in bronze, typed records in silver, and dimensional marts in gold
platforms.evidence_label: documented platform behavior plus illustrative transfer

platforms.name: Microsoft Fabric
platforms.revisit: warehouse schemas, surrogate-key generation, SCD processing, and audit attributes
platforms.integrity_boundary: warehouse foreign keys may be declared without enforcement, so ETL checks remain required
platforms.exercise: preserve Type 2 history and add relationship checks around the fact load
platforms.evidence_label: documented platform behavior plus illustrative transfer

platforms.name: dbt delivery layer
platforms.revisit: sources, staging, intermediate models, marts, materializations, tests, docs, and contracts
platforms.integrity_boundary: dbt encodes decisions and checks but cannot supply missing business meaning
platforms.exercise: map every DuckDB relation and claim into a reviewable dbt-shaped project tree
platforms.evidence_label: documented workflow pattern plus illustrative transfer
